item.title: The Healing Intelligence Of Silence
item.description: Healing Intelligence reveals itself when effort gives way to presence. When we stop trying to fix the body and allow experience to unfold, a deeper order emerges. In silence, the nervous system softens, identity loosens, and the body regains access to its natural capacity for reorganization, balance, and quiet restoration.

item.title: Parasocial Relationships and Mental Health: When One-Sided Bonds Comfort or Confuse Us
item.description: Parasocial relationships are one-sided emotional bonds formed through media figures, characters, or familiar voices. While these connections can offer comfort and stability, they may also blur emotional boundaries. Understanding how parasocial relationships affect mental health helps us recognise when they support wellbeing—and when they quietly replace real human connection.
